content.text:
Yes, this is really common at 20 months. Sudden night wakings often show up with a nap change, teething, a growth spurt, or big separation feelings.

Tonight, keep the 2am visit boring. Go in, keep the lights low, say a short calm phrase like "it's night, time to sleep," and settle them in the crib without picking them up or turning on a show. If you do the same quiet thing every time, the wakings usually fade faster.

If they seem sick or in pain, call Health811 at 811, any time, or 911 in an emergency.
